citation: Selvaraj S, et al. Sci Rep 2025;15:33067
protocol: Supplement (arginine plus citrulline malate) or placebo before a Wingate anaerobic test, a Harvard step test or a CrossFit workout; SBP, DBP and HR before and after the exercise
population: 46 healthy trained men, 24.8 +/- 5.0 y, split into three exercise groups
note: Placebo column; Wingate and step test are standardised external loads; CrossFit group has no absolute dose.
